title: CodyScript program
description: A program is an input: a literal or an input node, usually a block ({ "do": [...] }). Its root node may also define CodyScript functions ("fn") and declare the external functions the host provides ("ext"); "call" calls either kind. Every node is an object whose type is its key. The engine's compile() also checks what each call names, that no name is in both "fn" and "ext", that only external calls take "arg", that the host provides every "ext" function, nesting depth and finite numbers.

literal.description: A bare number, string, boolean or null is its own value. A string is text, never a variable.

node.description: An input node: exactly one of its types, each defined with the fields it may carry (closed where it's used: an input takes no others, the root also "fn" and "ext").

tag.description: An opaque label echoed back in errors.

functions.description: The program's own functions, by name: each a program of its own, whose only variables are its arguments. Names may contain dots ("text.size"), but none may also be in "ext". Only the root may carry it.

externals.description: The external functions the program may call, by executor: { "text": ["trim", "empty"] } declares text.trim and text.empty. The host must provide each. Only the root may carry it.

val.description: A constant of any type; nothing inside it is read as a node. Only needed for objects and arrays.

x.description: An expression over variables: numbers, 'text', true, false, null, names, + - * /, parentheses, one comparison (== != < <= > >=), && || and !. Syntax is checked by compile().

call.description: Calls a function: one key, its name — one the program defines in "fn" or declares in "ext" — whose value names the arguments to compute.

additionalProperties.description: Arguments, resolved in order. A CodyScript function's are its variables.

arg.description: A static argument, passed as written. Only for external functions.

block.description: Runs instructions in a new scope; its value is what it returns, else null.

set.description: Assigns one variable in the current scope: { "set": { "<name>": <input> } }.

ret.description: Ends the enclosing block with a value.

if.description: Runs do when the test is truthy, otherwise el.

for.description: Runs do while the test is truthy.
